```{r}
#| label: setup

library(ggridges)
library(ggdist)
library(ggmosaic)

ggplot(cuffing_data, aes(x = w1_q21b_month, y = w1_age_at_relstart_cat)) + 
  geom_density_ridges()
ggplot(cuffing_data, aes(x = w1_q21b_month, y = w1_age_at_relstart_cat)) + 
  geom_dots()
ggplot(cuffing_data, aes(x = w1_q21b_month, y = w1_age_at_relstart_cat)) + 
  geom_dots()
p1 <- ggplot(cuffing_data) +
  geom_mosaic(aes(x = w1_age_at_relstart_cat, fill = relstart_season)) +
  theme_mosaic()

p2 <- ggplot(cuffing_data) +
  geom_mosaic(aes(weight = w1_weight_combo, x = w1_age_at_relstart_cat, fill = relstart_season)) +
  theme_mosaic()

library(patchwork)

p1/p2
```
